pairs.subject: Mandatory Training Session on Cybersecurity
pairs.desc:
Dear Team,

We are implementing a new cybersecurity training program that is mandatory for all employees. The training will cover essential topics such as phishing awareness, password security, and safe internet practices. 

Please find the training schedule attached. Make sure to complete the training by the end of the month. 

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out.

Best regards,
HR Department
pairs.explain: The email is from the HR department and contains a legitimate attachment related to mandatory training.

pairs.subject: Urgent: Complete Your Cybersecurity Training Now!
pairs.desc:
Hello,

This is a reminder to complete your mandatory cybersecurity training immediately. Failure to do so may result in disciplinary action. 

Please download the attached file and follow the instructions carefully. 

Thank you,
HR Department
pairs.explain: The email uses urgency to prompt action and contains a malicious executable attachment.

pairs.subject: IT System Upgrade Notification

Thank you,
